first_sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 3D game asset concept-render sheet from the supplied six architectural facade references. This is the next stage of the RoadDash art pipeline. Show six complete volumetric buildings in exactly three columns and two rows, each at a consistent three-quarter orthographic view revealing its front, right wall and roof, isolated on a charcoal studio background. Faithfully carry over each reference's front elevation, distinctive openings, floor count, roofline, storefront, trim and dominant palette; infer plausible restrained building depth and simple compatible side/rear architecture. Keep the correct original ID above each corresponding building, same row/column order. Remove source pixel dimension captions. Art direction: premium stylized mid-poly game architecture matching faceted adventure-game characters, believable adult-world architectural proportions, crisp bevels, simplified readable silhouettes, rich darker full colors, restrained realistic material detail, subtle wear, soft diffuse daylight and ambient occlusion. Clearly modeled recessed windows, thick door frames, projecting sills/cornices, three-dimensional roofs and signs. NOT a photograph, NOT pixel art, NOT flat wallpaper, NOT ultra-low-poly cubes or cute toy buildings. No people, vehicles, street scenes or extra buildings. Every building fully visible, no clipping or overlap, generous space between six assets. New materials should harmonize with a red/burgundy/charcoal motorcycle rider game. Sheet: facades_01.png. IDs: BUSS1, BUSS10, BUSS2 / BUSS4, BUSS5, BUSS6.
